description.zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

descriptions.zh: 如果存在正在运行的构建任务，则不允许直接删除模板，需要等待构建任务达到终态：成功（SUCCESS）、失败（FAILED）、测试失败（TEST_FAILED）、部分成功（PARTITION_SUCCESS）或已取消（CANCELLED）。构建任务的详细信息可以通过DescribeImagePipelineExecutions查询。
descriptions.en: If a build task is currently running, you cannot directly delete the template. Wait until the build task reaches a desired state: SUCCESS, FAILED, TEST_FAILED, PARTITION_SUCCESS, or CANCELLED. You can call [DescribeImagePipelineExecutions](~~25609~~) to query the details of build tasks.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs delete-image-pipeline --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-pipeline-id ip-2ze5tsl5bp6nf2b30000 --region cn-hangzhou
